title: Managed graph loop owner keeps ready work anchored
summary: The no-active-loop failure came from normal ready-task dispatch being session-driven: /loop/status could be empty while ready tasks existed, and /next-action previously only iterated active loops. The daemon now owns a deterministic per-workspace sessionless managed graph loop, ensures it on boot, periodic liveness sweeps, and next_action when normal ready work exists, and leaves standing harness drains to the headless drain path.
